_meta.method: complete direct literal rendering; source order preserved; no explanatory paraphrase

word_for_word: यदप्युक्तं पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान् इति तत्राह सुखदुःखे इति
regarding what was also said, ‘sin alone would take hold of us,’ he replies with ‘pleasure and pain’
सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा
making pleasure and pain equal
तथा तयोः कारणभूतौ यौ लाभालाभावपि
likewise gain and loss, which are causes of those two
तयोरपि कारणभूतौ जयाजयावपि समौ कृत्वा
and making victory and defeat, the causes of those also, equal
एतेषां समत्वे कारणं हर्षविषादराहित्यम्
the cause of equality regarding these is absence of elation and dejection
युज्यस्व सन्नद्धो भव
engage yourself; become prepared
सुखाद्यभिलाषं हित्वा स्वधर्मबुद्ध्या युध्यमानः पापं न प्राप्स्यसीत्यर्थः
abandoning desire for pleasure and the rest and fighting with the understanding that it is your own dharma, you will not incur sin; this is the meaning
उपदिष्टं ज्ञानयोगमुपसंहरंस्तत्साधनं कर्मयोगं प्रस्तौति एषा त इति
concluding the yoga of knowledge that has been taught, he introduces karma-yoga, its means, with ‘this to you’
सम्यक् ख्यायते प्रकाश्यते वस्तुतत्त्वमनयेति संख्या सम्यग्ज्ञानम्
that by which the truth of a thing is correctly declared, made manifest, is ‘saṃkhyā,’ right knowledge
तस्मिन्प्रकाशमानमात्मतत्त्वं सांख्यं तस्मिन्करणीया बुद्धिरेषा तवाभिहिता
the truth of the Self manifest in that is Sāṅkhya; the understanding to be employed therein has been stated to you
एवमभिहितायामपि सांख्यबुद्धौ तव चेदात्मतत्त्वमपरोक्षं न संभवति
if, even though the Sāṅkhya understanding has thus been stated, direct realization of the Self does not arise for you
तर्ह्यन्तःकरणशुद्धिद्वाराऽत्मतत्त्वापरोक्षार्थं कर्मयोगे त्विमां बुद्धिं शृणु
then hear this understanding concerning karma-yoga for direct realization of the Self through purification of the inner instrument
यया बुद्ध्या युक्तः परमेश्वरार्पितकर्मयोगेन शुद्धान्तःकरणः सन्
endowed with which understanding, having a purified inner instrument through karma-yoga in which action is offered to the Supreme Lord
तत्प्रसादप्राप्तापरोक्षज्ञानेन कर्मात्मकं बन्धं प्रकर्षेण हास्यसि त्यक्ष्यसि
through direct knowledge obtained by His grace you will thoroughly cast off, abandon, bondage consisting of action
ननु कृष्यादिवत्कर्मणां कदाचिद्विघ्नबाहुल्येन फले व्याभिचारान्मन्त्राद्यङ्गवैगुण्येन च प्रत्यवायसंभवात्कुतः कर्मयोगेन कर्मबन्धप्रहरणं तत्राह नेहेति

objection: as with agriculture and the like, actions may fail in their result through many obstacles, and defects in auxiliaries such as mantras may produce adverse consequences; how then can karma-yoga destroy the bondage of action? to this he says ‘here there is no’
इह निष्कामकर्मयोगेऽभिक्रमस्य प्रारम्भस्य नाशो निष्फलत्वं नास्ति
here, in desireless karma-yoga, there is no destruction, no fruitlessness, of an undertaking once begun
प्रत्यवायश्च न विद्यते ईश्वरोद्देशेनैव विघ्नवैगुण्याद्यसंभवात्
nor is there adverse consequence, because when the Lord alone is the purpose, obstacles, defects, and the like do not arise in that way
किंच अस्य धर्मस्य स्वल्पमप्युपक्रममात्रमपि कृतं महतो भयात्संसारान्त्रायते रक्षति
and further, even a little of this dharma, even merely beginning it, saves and protects from the great fear of saṃsāra
नतु काम्यकर्मवत्किंचिदङ्गवैगुण्यादिना नैष्फल्यमस्येत्यर्थः
unlike desire-motivated action, it does not become fruitless because of some defect in an auxiliary; this is the meaning
कुत इत्यपेक्षायामुभयोर्वैषम्यमाह व्यवसायेति
when it is asked why, he states the difference between the two with ‘resolute’
इहेश्वराराधनलक्षणे कर्मयोगे व्यवसायात्मिका परमेश्वरभक्त्यैव ध्रुवं तरिष्यामीति निश्चयात्मिका एकैवैकनिष्ठैव बुद्धिर्भवति
here, in karma-yoga characterized by worship of the Lord, there is one single-pointed resolute understanding: ‘through devotion to the Supreme Lord alone I shall certainly cross over’
अव्यवसायिनां तु बहुर्मुखानां कामिनां कामानामानन्त्यादनन्ताः
but for the irresolute, the many-directed persons of desire, understandings are endless because desires are endless
तत्रापि कर्मगुणफलादिभेदाद्बहुशाखाश्च बुद्धयो भवन्ति
and they are many-branched because of distinctions among actions, qualities, fruits, and the like
ईश्वराराधनार्थं हि नित्यनैमित्तिकं कर्म किंचिदङ्गवैगुण्येनापि न नश्यति
obligatory and occasional action done for worship of the Lord is not lost even if some auxiliary is defective
यथा शक्नुयात्तथा कुर्यादिति हि तद्विधीयते
for it is enjoined: ‘one should perform it according to one’s capacity’
नच वैगुण्यम् ईश्वरोद्देशेनैव वैगुण्योपरमात्
nor is there defect, since defect ceases when the Lord alone is the purpose
नतु तथा काम्यं कर्म अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात्स्वर्गकामः दध्नेन्द्रियकामो जुहुयात् इति
desire-motivated action is not so, as in ‘one desiring heaven should perform Agnihotra’ and ‘one desiring sense-power should offer with curds’
अतो महद्वैषम्यमिति भावः
therefore there is a great difference; this is the intention
ननु कामिनोऽपि कष्टान्कामान्विहाय व्यवसायात्मिकामेव बुद्धिं किं न कुर्वन्ति तत्राह यामिति
objection: why do persons of desire not abandon difficult desires and cultivate only resolute understanding? to this he says ‘which’
पुष्पितां विषलतावदापातरमणीयां प्रकृष्टां परमार्थफलपरामेव वदन्ति वाचं स्वर्गादिफलश्रुतिं ये

those who speak the flowery word, the scriptural promise of heaven and other fruits, as if it alone were excellent and concerned with the highest result, attractive at first like a poisonous creeper in flower
तेषां तया वाचापहृतचेतसां व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिर्न विधीयत इति तृतीयेनान्वयः
for them, whose minds are carried away by that speech, resolute understanding does not arise; this is connected with the third verse
किमिति तथा वदन्ति यतोऽविपश्चितो मूढाः
why do they speak so? because they are undiscerning, deluded
तत्र हेतुः वेदे ये वादा अर्थवादाः अक्षय्यं ह वै चातुर्मास्ययाजिनः सुकृतं भवति अपाम सोमममृता अभूम इत्याद्यास्तेष्वेव रताः प्रीताः
the reason: they delight only in Vedic laudatory statements such as ‘the merit of the performer of the Cāturmāsya is indeed imperishable’ and ‘we drank Soma and became immortal’
अतएव अतः परमन्यदीश्वरतत्त्वं प्राप्यं नास्तीति वचनशीलाः
therefore they habitually say that beyond this there is no other reality, the Lord, to be attained
अतएव कामात्मान इति
therefore, with ‘whose nature is desire’
कामात्मानः कामाकुलचित्ताः
‘whose nature is desire’ means whose minds are overwhelmed by desire
अतः स्वर्ग एव परः पुरुषार्थो येषां ते
therefore heaven alone is their supreme human goal
जन्म च तत्र कर्माणि च तत्फलानि च प्रददातीति तथा ताम्
that speech gives birth there, actions, and their fruits
भोगैश्वर्ययोर्गतिं प्राप्तिं प्रति साधनभूता ये क्रियाविशेषास्ते बहुला यस्यां तां प्रवदन्तीत्यनुषङ्गः
the construction continues: they proclaim speech containing many particular rites that are means to attaining enjoyment and lordship
ततश्च भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानामिति
and therefore, with ‘attached to enjoyment and lordship’
भोगैश्वर्ययोः प्रसक्तानामभिनिविष्टानाम्
those attached, deeply fixed, upon enjoyment and lordship
तया पुष्पितया वाचापहृतमाकृष्टं चेतो येषां तेषाम्
whose minds are stolen, drawn away, by that flowery speech
समाधिः चित्तैकाग्र्यं परमेश्वरैकाग्र्याभिमुखत्वं तस्मिन्निश्चयात्मिका बुद्धिर्न विधीयते
in samādhi—one-pointedness of mind, orientation toward one-pointedness in the Supreme Lord—resolute understanding does not arise
कर्मकर्तरिप्रयोगः नोत्पद्यत इत्यर्थः
the passive expression has the sense of the active: it does not arise; this is the meaning
ननु च यदि स्वर्गादिकं परमं फलं न भवति तर्हि किमिति वेदैस्तत्साधनतया कर्माणि विधीयन्ते तत्राह त्रैगुण्यविषया इति
objection: if heaven and the like are not the supreme result, why do the Vedas prescribe actions as means to them? to this he says ‘having the three guṇas as their field’
त्रिगुणात्मकाः सकामा येऽधिकारिणस्तद्विषयास्तेषां कर्मफलसंबन्धप्रतिपादका वेदाः
the Vedas concern qualified persons who possess the three guṇas and act with desire, teaching the relation between their actions and fruits
त्वं तु निस्त्रैगुण्यो निष्कामो भव
but you should become free from the three guṇas, without desire
तत्रोपायमाह निर्द्वन्द्वः सुखदुःखशीतोष्णादियुगुलानि द्वन्द्वानि तद्रहितो भव
he states the means: become free of pairs; pleasure and pain, heat and cold, and similar pairs are ‘dvandvas’; be free from them
तानि सहस्वेत्यर्थः
endure them; this is the meaning
कथमित्यत्राह नित्यसत्त्वस्थः सन् धैर्यमवलम्ब्येत्यर्थः
how? he says: remaining always established in sattva, that is, taking support in firmness
तथा निर्योगक्षेमः अप्राप्तस्वीकारो योगः प्राप्तपरिपालनं क्षेमं तद्रहितः
likewise be free from acquisition and preservation: obtaining what has not been obtained is yoga; preserving what has been obtained is kṣema; be free from these
आत्मवानप्रमत्तः
be self-possessed, not heedless
नहि द्वन्द्वाकुलस्य योगक्षेमव्यापृतस्य च प्रमादिनस्त्रैगुण्यातिक्रमः संभवतीति
for one agitated by pairs, occupied with acquisition and preservation, and heedless cannot transcend the three guṇas
